thi-ap17:178.2: nopadissati → nopaṭiyādi (bj: machasaṁ) | nopaṭiyādi → nopadissati (cck: sī. pī.); sāriputtādi (cck: syā.) | padissati → G. P. no patiyādi; S2 no patissādi. (pts note)
thi-ap17:178.4: sāriputtādikā tathā → sārīputtādikā yathā (sya-all) | sāriputtādikā → sāriputatādi (bj: syā) | tathā → yathā (cck: syā.)
thi-ap17:179.3: gandhacuṇṇapakiṇṇāni → gandhacuṇṇāvakiṇṇāni (bj) | gandhacuṇṇapakiṇṇāni jhāpayiṁsu → gandhacuṇṇādi kiṇṇāni jhāpayīsu (pts) | kiṇṇāni → S2 -cuṇṇā ca kiṇṇāni. (pts note)
thi-ap17:179.4: jhāpayīsu → G. jhāpayiṁsu. (pts note) | tahiṁ → S2 va tā. (pts note)
thi-ap17:181.2: ḍayhañcassā → daḍḍhaṁ cassā (bj, sya-all) | cassā → ḍayyāñcassā (bj: machasaṁ) | assā → G. va 'ssā; S1 vā yā; P. daḷhaṁ-. (pts note)
thi-ap17:181.3: saṅketaṁ → saṅke haṁ (bj) | haṁ → saṅketaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, syā, PTS) | *sa*ṅketaṁ → S2 saṅkehaṁ. (pts note)
thi-ap17:182.1: gotamidhātūni → gotamīdhātūni (pts) | Gotamīdhātūni → G. mātuni. (pts note)

thi-ap17:185.4: natthi sokapariddavo → na sokaparidevanā (sya-all) | sokapariddavo → na sokaparidevanā (cck: syā.)

thi-ap17:188.2: dibbāya → S1 āsi nibbāya. (pts note) | sotadhātuyā → G. mātūyā. (pts note)
thi-ap17:189.4: tassā → dāni (sya-all) | tassā → G. dāni; S1 tassa dāni. (pts note)
